methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'Our long-term success depends on intellectual property protection.' (FY2008 10-K, Item 1A heading); 'Several major products will lose intellectual property protection in the U.S. in the next decade beginning in late 2011.' (FY2008 10-K, Item 1A); 'Several of these products will lose intellectual property protection in various countries outside the U.S. even before then.' (FY2008 10-K, Item 1A); 'Our product sales can be adversely affected by the introduction by competitors of branded products that are perceived as superior by the marketplace, by generic versions of our branded products, and by generic versions of other products in the same therapeutic class as our branded products.' (FY2008 10-K, Item 1A); 'Zyprexa sales of $4.70 billion represented 23 percent of our revenues in 2008, and Cymbalta sales of $2.70 billion constituted 13 percent of our 2008 revenues.' (FY2008 10-K, Item 1A)

BEAR.desc: EPS -30.0%/yr (worst year FY99-FY07, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +3.1%/yr (Q4 sales ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY08 median

BULL.desc: EPS +3.1%/yr (FY99-FY07 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +21.7%/yr (best 2-yr run FY99-FY07); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LLY (retrospective, 2009-04-03) ◉ BUY — Ratio B -0.09x (-27.2% downside to Bear $42 / +318.1% upside to Bull $138) | Adj composite 2.30 vs market 1.00: gap +1.30 [UNDERVALUED] | -62% above the EPP floor $87 (21x FY09E $4.12) | Conservative 2-yr case: +270.0% total (+135.0%/yr) | At 8.0x FY09E the 15% hurdle price $44 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. revenues +3.0% in Q4 2008, forward revenues +3% (no FY09 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2008 net sales growth ex-FX); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
